name: Dominica

fees.name: Visitor's visa (embassy/consulate application)
fees.applies: nationalities not on Dominica's visa-exempt list
fees.notes: Official portal states 'The application fee is $200.00 to be paid at the Treasury department' without specifying currency; payment at the Dominica Treasury implies Eastern Caribbean dollars (XCD), though some third-party sources describe it as USD. Currency unverified on an official source - treat amount as $200 with currency ambiguity.

fees.name: In-transit entry (no visa required)
fees.applies: all in-transit passengers and bona fide tourists holding a return ticket
fees.notes: No separate transit visa or fee exists; any in-transit passenger or bona fide tourist with a return ticket may enter visa-free for up to 21 days.

free_visa_notes: Dominica has a very liberal visa regime: citizens of the Commonwealth (incl. GBR, CAN, IND-see note, NGA, PAK), CARICOM, USA and several EU states enter visa-free for up to 6 months; nationals of most other EU states, China, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, Venezuela etc. for up to 3 months; and any bona fide tourist or in-transit passenger with a return ticket for up to 21 days. There is no e-visa, eTA, or visa-on-arrival programme; the only travel formality is the free online ED card (edcard.dominica.gov.dm). Only a small set of nationalities need the embassy-issued visitor's visa. No separate business-visa fee schedule is published; the single visa application form and $200 fee apply.
